data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of $0.8 million in prior year reserves, representing 0.55% of opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by a loss of $8.1 million attributable to the 2020 year of account, which closed with adverse claims activity from natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Ida, Laura, and Storm Uri. This was partially offset by a $7.3 million surplus on the reinsurance to close for the 2019 year of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net figure due to the absence of a gross breakdown and distortion in the claims development triangle from Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions. Gross premium mix percentages are derived from gross premiums earned and applied to gross premiums written.
